summary: Code review completed for visibility toggle bug fixes. All 6 features verified via code inspection. MapView.js handleToggleTeamVisibility now uses optimistic setTeamDeals() instead of fetchTeamData(). DealDetails.js has new Visibility section with toggle button calling PUT /api/deals/:id/visibility. Backend endpoint returns deal with updated team_id. mapview_no_fetchTeamData_on_toggle.details: Line 867-890: handleToggleTeamVisibility does NOT call fetchTeamData() or fetchDeals(). Uses optimistic setTeamDeals() to add/remove deal from teamDeals state.

mapview_optimistic_teamDeals_update.details: Lines 883-886: When sharing, adds deal to teamDeals via setTeamDeals(prev => [...prev.filter(d => d.id !== selectedDeal.id), {...selectedDeal, team_id: newTeamId}]). When making private, removes deal via setTeamDeals(prev => prev.filter(d => d.id !== selectedDeal.id)).

dealdetails_visibility_section_visible.details: Lines 687-729: Visibility section with data-testid='deal-visibility-section' renders for deal owners (isOwner check at line 688). Shows current state with Users/Eye icons and text 'Shared with Team'/'Private'.

dealdetails_visibility_toggle_button.details: Lines 714-726: Toggle button with data-testid='deal-visibility-toggle' exists. Button text shows 'Make Private' when shared, 'Share with Team' when private. onClick calls handleToggleVisibility.

dealdetails_toggle_calls_api.details: Lines 266-282: handleToggleVisibility calls PUT /api/deals/${dealId}/visibility with {shared_with_team: !isCurrentlyShared}. Updates deal state on success without page refresh.

backend_visibility_endpoint_returns_team.details: Lines 347-383 in deals.py: PUT /{deal_id}/visibility endpoint returns {success: true, deal: {..., team_id: ...}, shared_with_team: bool}. Sets team_id to user's team when sharing, null when making private.

mapview_visibility_toggle.before: Previous implementation called fetchTeamData() after visibility toggle, causing map position to reset
mapview_visibility_toggle.after: Now uses optimistic setTeamDeals() to add/remove deal from local state without network refetch

dealdetails_visibility_section.handler: handleToggleVisibility (lines 266-282) calls PUT /api/deals/:id/visibility and updates local state

issue_1_map_position_jump.root_cause: handleToggleTeamVisibility was calling fetchTeamData() which refetched all team deals and potentially reset map state
issue_1_map_position_jump.fix: Replaced fetchTeamData() call with optimistic setTeamDeals() that adds/removes single deal from local state without network refetch

issue_2_missing_visibility_toggle_on_dea.fix: Added Visibility section (lines 686-729) with handleToggleVisibility function (lines 266-282) that calls PUT /api/deals/:id/visibility endpoint
